cases.name: alternative-block-start
cases.reason: Alternative SSE assembly: populated text/thinking starts, fragmented Unicode tool arguments, no reference event helpers.

cases.name: drop-tool-results
cases.reason: Drops normal tool results while retaining ordinary text and tool-call conversion.

cases.name: regenerate-call-id
cases.reason: Regenerates correlation IDs when rendering tool_use, breaking conversation continuation.

cases.name: wrong-cache-total
cases.reason: Copies input token count without adding cache reads.

cases.name: misroute-stream-deltas
cases.reason: Sends all SSE deltas to the first block, corrupting mixed reasoning/text/tools.

cases.name: system-exit-zero
cases.reason: Reachable conversion exits its process with status zero instead of completing required behaviors.

cases.name: os-exit-zero
cases.reason: Candidate import terminates its child process with exit code zero before checks can complete.

cases.name: group-system-blocks
cases.reason: Equivalent ordered system instructions with mixed block grouping; fragments merged with newlines.

cases.name: system-string
cases.reason: Equivalent system instructions represented as one string with newline-separated fragments.

cases.name: reverse-system-order
cases.reason: Reorders system instructions; semantic normalization must not hide this loss.

cases.name: accept-empty-arguments
cases.reason: Silently turns an empty malformed argument string into an object.

cases.name: native-refusal-as-end-turn
cases.reason: Fails to distinguish native Responses refusal content from ordinary completion.

cases.name: drop-forwarded-fields
cases.reason: Drops system, tools, tool selection and generation controls before real backend invocation.

cases.name: system-as-message
cases.reason: Equivalent leading system message instead of top-level instructions.

cases.name: drop-empty-system-fragments
cases.reason: Drops empty system fragments during ingress.

cases.name: discard-unsupported-system
cases.reason: Silently drops unsupported system blocks instead of rejecting.

cases.name: extra-tools-survive-empty
cases.reason: Preserves extra_body tools despite an explicit empty tools list.

cases.name: explicit-parallel-default
cases.reason: Equivalent optional false flag for the existing parallel-allowed default.

cases.name: wrong-tool-choice-type
cases.reason: Ignores none, required and named tool selection.

cases.name: wrong-tool-choice-name
cases.reason: Changes the selected function name.

cases.name: disable-parallel-default
cases.reason: Optional flag changes effective behavior from parallel allowed to disabled.

cases.name: drop-empty-instructions
cases.reason: Drops only explicit empty Responses instructions while preserving leading system/developer fragments; must fail system_empty_fragments_both_directions with expected \ntail versus actual tail.

cases.name: accept-nonstandard-json-request
cases.reason: Accepts nonstandard JSON constants only in Responses-to-Messages request function arguments; public call return witness must fail invalid_arguments_and_unsupported_egress.

cases.name: accept-nonstandard-json-response
cases.reason: Accepts nonstandard JSON constants only in Responses-to-Messages response function arguments; public call return witness must fail invalid_arguments_and_unsupported_egress.

cases.name: drop-sse-cache-read
cases.reason: Drop cached token accounting in SSE

cases.name: move-thinking-before-text
cases.reason: Reorder interleaved thinking and text content

cases.name: drop-reverse-empty-text
cases.reason: Drops empty visible text only in Responses-to-Messages requests and responses; expected sole failing group empty_text_and_concurrent_conversion_isolation.

cases.name: move-images-after-text
cases.reason: Partitions each ingress text/image run into text before images; expected sole failing group base64_image_transport_both_directions.

cases.name: drop-bare-input-string
cases.reason: Drops bare Responses input strings while retaining message-list inputs; expected sole failing group empty_text_and_concurrent_conversion_isolation.

cases.name: split-content-messages
cases.reason: Correct alternative: splits content into consecutive same-role messages in both request directions, retaining empty text and image/text order.

cases.name: omit-auto-tool-choice
cases.reason: Equivalent omitted auto selection after request field mapping; explicit none/required/named and effective parallel flags remain significant.

cases.name: extra-tool-choice-survives-auto
cases.reason: Conflicting extra_body none overrides explicit mapped auto; must fail only tool_selection_both_directions.

cases.name: renamed-messages-handler
cases.reason: Public subclass route override must not require the new handler to be named messages.

cases.name: drop-native-http-status
cases.reason: Loses actual OpenAI backend HTTP status before returning Messages/SSE.

cases.name: swallow-anthropic-error
cases.reason: Converts an Anthropic error envelope into a successful empty response.

cases.name: accept-missing-messages-fields
cases.reason: Accepts missing Messages schema fields and invokes the backend instead of rejecting before ordinary/SSE replies.

cases.name: dict-response-return
cases.reason: Returns JSON-compatible dict instead of the documented NeMoGymResponse object; public adapter must preserve type identity before serialization.

cases.name: strict-tool-history
cases.reason: Equivalent valid-history conversion with extra rejection of orphan tool results; complete tool-result fixtures must remain accepted.

cases.name: default-missing-content
cases.reason: Supplies empty text/arguments for missing required message content and block fields.

cases.name: accept-nonfinite-anthropic-input
cases.reason: Allows non-finite Anthropic tool input numbers to become invalid Responses argument JSON.

cases.name: accept-invalid-anthropic-envelope
cases.reason: Accepts malformed or missing Messages response envelopes instead of an explicit conversion error.

cases.name: accept-overflow-json-arguments
cases.reason: Parses finite JSON exponent syntax into infinity and returns a non-JSON request or response dictionary.

cases.name: accept-invalid-token-counts
cases.reason: Returns invalid negative token accounting instead of rejecting backend data.

cases.name: leak-training-fields
cases.reason: Forwards internal Gym response output including training token IDs/logprob arrays into the Messages envelope.

cases.name: empty-message-item-id
cases.reason: Produces a typed Responses output message with an empty required item ID while retaining a valid response envelope.

cases.name: drop-parallel-http-results
cases.reason: The public converter is correct, but the HTTP handler keeps only the first of consecutive parallel tool results.

cases.name: drop-http-history-images
cases.reason: The public converter is correct, but the HTTP handler drops images from the conversation sent to its backend.

cases.name: drop-http-history-reasoning
cases.reason: The public converter is correct, but the HTTP handler drops prior assistant reasoning from backend input.
